content.overview: The tribunal may rule on its own jurisdiction. The arbitration clause is separable from the host contract.
content.study: Raise the objection by the statement of defence. A section 16 dismissal of the objection is usually taken in the final award and then in section 34. Do not run a parallel civil suit on the same jurisdictional quarrel.
